title: Rebuild + commit docs/ for GitHub Pages
description: Earlier commits only updated source files; project serves the docs/ directory on GitHub Pages (per package.json build:pages). Without running build:pages and committing the output, GitHub Pages kept serving the old build (calcrepo-v1 SW, no .settings-drawer__panel CSS). Fix: run npm run build:pages, commit the regenerated docs/ tree, push.

title: Back button: close drawer via history pushState
description: Mobile: back button on Settings/History drawer should close the drawer, not navigate away. Two bugs: (1) useUrlParams.write uses history.replaceState so back doesn't traverse drawer entries; (2) readState returns undefined for missing params, and AppShell's URL listener skips undefined values, so even on popstate the drawer stays open. Fix: write() accepts {push} option, pushState when drawer just opened (false→true transition tracked via ref); readState always returns booleans; AppShell always syncs the new state from URL on popstate.

title: Fix Settings drawer layout (mobile + desktop)
description: Settings drawer > * selector applies 380px width to every direct child (header + each section), making them render as side-by-side columns. On mobile this hides most sections. Fix: add backdrop + single scrollable panel wrapper in SettingsDrawer.tsx, rewrite .settings-drawer CSS to stack header/sections vertically inside one panel. Add mobile breakpoint so drawer goes full-width on small screens. Also close-on-backdrop-click + ESC key.

title: UI/UX polish batch: key feedback, copy toast, tokens, repeat label, Hindi, settings cards, expression scroll
description:
Batch UI/UX improvements driven by audit:
1. .key needs :hover/:active feedback (touch users get no visual tap confirmation).
2. Copy button: brief 'Copied!' state or toast so users know clipboard was hit.
3. Token cleanup: --color-danger and --color-error are duplicated (#b91c1c light, #f87171 dark); consolidate to --color-error and migrate all references.
4. BasicView 'Repeat (+)' button: change label to 'Repeat last result' and add title tooltip explaining it appends the previous result with '+'.
5. Settings language: add Hindi (hi) as a real selectable option, keep EN as default, add a 'coming soon' note for others.
6. Settings sections: card-style visual grouping (background/padding/border-radius), bump section gap.
7. Skip — close button is fine.
8. .display__expression: switch from word-break:break-all to overflow-x:auto + white-space:nowrap so long expressions scroll horizontally instead of breaking numbers.
9. Mode tabs: minor — keep flex-wrap but tighten row-gap; not converting to dropdown yet (user noted future consideration).

Verify: typecheck, lint, tests, build:pages; bump SW v6→v7; commit; push.

title: History UI/UX improvements + manual save for inline entries
description:
Multiple issues to address:
1. History panel card layout is left-heavy — expression/meta/actions all stack on the left, leaving the right side empty. Use a 2-col grid: expression+meta on the left, actions on the right spanning both rows (vertically centered).
2. Wording inconsistency between settings label ('Remember calculation history') and the off-notice ('History is off. Enable it in settings...'). Unify on 'Auto-save' wording: settings label = 'Auto-save calculation history'; notice = 'Auto-save history is off. Enable it in settings to start recording calculations.'
3. Math history IS being saved via record() in AppShell.handleBasicHistory when settings.enabled — confirmed by reading the flow. But user wants verification.
4. Inline (calculator below) history has no save action when auto-save is off. Add forceRecord to useHistory and show a 'Save' button per inline entry when settings.enabled is false (BasicView + ScientificView).
5. Bump SW VERSION.
6. Build, commit, push.

title: Scientific view: split keypad into functions + digits grids
description: Functions (~19) and digits (16) live in the same CSS grid, so when function count isn't divisible by 4 the last row has a stray cell that gets filled by '7', breaking the 4x4 digit block. Restructure keypad into .keypad--scientific-functions (action + π/e/%/^ + all scientific functions) and .keypad--scientific-digits (7..+ plus =), stacked vertically. Both grids keep the same column structure (6 desktop, 4 mobile).

title: Scientific view: align memory row with keypad buttons
description: On Scientific calculator the memory row (M+ M- MR MC) uses a 4-col grid (.scientific-view__memory) while the keypad below uses 6-col on desktop / 4-col on mobile. Result: memory buttons are 1.5x the width of C, backspace, (, ) on desktop, and even on mobile the rows look visually disconnected. Fix: make the memory row use the same column count as the keypad (6 desktop, 4 mobile via @media), each memory button spans 1 col, accept 2 empty cols on the right on desktop. Also tighten the gap between the memory row and the keypad to feel like one unit.
